[[File:Grumani_temple_chamber.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Grumani temple chamber on Skarpos]]
The '''Grumani temple chamber''' was located within the [[Morbollon Mesa]] on [[Skarpos]]. Prior to the [[Republic Dark Age]], it was used to hide the [[Helm of Ieldis]], an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] created by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ieldis]] which was capable of driving sentient beings into a homicidal frenzy. The temple chamber had been built by the [[Grumani Hierophant]]s, a religious sect.

In [[1038 BBY]], [[Aron Holt|Aron]] and [[Mercia Holt]] discovered the chamber while on their [[Project Pandemonium|quest]] to locate the Helm. In an attempt to deny the Helm to the Sith, they detonated the chamber with explosives; killing themselves. Before their deaths, they left a [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecording]] explaining their motives and actions. However, the Helm survived due to its [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] powers, and it was subsequently recovered by Sith Lord [[Odion]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. He attempted to use the Helm to initiate a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-induced galactic apocalypse but was thwarted by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] and her former [[General/Legends|general]], [[Beld Yulan]].
